chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Manṣūr ibn Yūnus, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام): A man said to me: Recognize the last of the Imams, and it will not harm you that you do not recognize the first.
He said: So he said: May Allah curse this one, for I hate him and do not recognize him. And can the last be recognized except by the first?

key_terms.أُبْغِضُهُ: I hate him; indicating strong disavowal of the speaker's claim
key_terms.الْآخِرَ: the last Imam in the line of the Imams
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams, the divinely appointed leaders
key_terms.الْأَوَّلَ: the first Imam, whose recognition grounds recognition of those after him
key_terms.عُرِفَ: was recognized; meaning properly known and identified
key_terms.لَعَنَ اللَّهُ: may Allah curse; a forceful condemnation of false belief

ai.seo_question: Can a person recognize only the last Imam without recognizing the first Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that recognition of the Imams is an interconnected matter and cannot be separated by accepting some while neglecting others. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام) strongly rejects the claim that knowing the later Imam suffices without knowing the first, emphasizing continuity in Imamate and rightful religious authority.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A man said to me, ‘If you were to recognise the last of the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, it would not harm you if you do not recognise the first of the Imams<sup>asws</sup>’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Curse this one, for I<sup>asws</sup> hate him and do not recognise him! And, can the last one be recognised except with the first one?’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following.
“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), “A man said to me, “You must know the last of the Imams and it does not matter if you would not know the first of the Imams.”
The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) said, “May Allah condemn this. I am angry with him and I do not know him. How can the last Imam be recognized except through the first Imam?”
